arrangement.description: Glass Harbor variation A arranged over 32 bars. Bars 1-8 are drums and pad. Bars 9-16 add bass and keys. Bars 17-24 add the lead. Bars 25-32 keep drums, pad, bass, and lead, and leave the keys out. Each musical track is one or more copies of the 8-bar part, placed at the listed bar offsets.

identity_check.method: For each core role, variation A and variation B differ in rhythm. Variation B is not a uniform transpose of variation A. No pitched part is a transposed copy of another pitched part with the same velocities. Variation A attack-time tuples are unique across the four kits.
